title: Someone KNOCKS In My Stepdad's Dream 🛏️
premise: In our town, if you sleep on someone else's pillow you dream their dream, and my stepdad's pillow dreams the same thing every night: two knocks at his front door, and a voice yelling Dad.
twist: The voice is mine at sixteen, locked out my first week in his house, the first time I ever called him Dad, and he never opens the door because the dream ends when he does.
world: A bright guest room with a striped quilt, my stepdad's sunny front hall and kitchen, and the same hall in his dream, warm sunset gold, with a staircase and a white front door.
